name: Terminal49
description: Terminal49 helps users find and monitor ocean shipments and containers, inspect routes and transport events, check supported shipping lines, and create new tracking requests.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Terminal49 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Terminal49 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.terminal49.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Terminal49 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Terminal49 provides these MCP tools: get_container, get_container_route, get_container_transport_events, get_shipment_details, get_supported_shipping_lines, list_containers, list_shipments, list_tracking_requests, search_container, and track_container.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Terminal49?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Terminal49 in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Terminal49 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Terminal49 is developed by Terminal49, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
